card.name: Verb or 'in' just before a proportion
card.fires_on: Small words such as 'in', 'a', 'the' or a verb like 'caused' or 'had' right after a finding was reported, where a percentage or share of patients comes next. Seen in trial results and risk descriptions.

modes.label: 'in' before a share
modes.description: The word 'in' after an observed finding, just before a percentage of patients.
modes.example: hepatitis C causes chronic disease<< in>> about 80 percent of people.

modes.label: Verb before an outcome rate
modes.description: A verb such as caused or had that leads into a rate or probability.
modes.example: treatment with COPIKTRA<< caused>> increased treatment-related mortality

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning 'majority' or 'most', so a proportion phrase follows.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that comes just before the text says how many or what share of patients were affected.
